chapter: Claude Hopkins, Fletcher Henderson and Fats Waller
title: Introduced to Hopkins's band and leaving over the clique
summary: Mosley was featured at the Apollo but a clique in the band led him to leave.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: Okay, so that's how you were introduced to Claude's band.
I was introduced to Claude's band at the Regal Theatre doing "Blue Memories" and then we played quite a few theatres
and a few one nighters and we got back into New York in the fall of '34 and I went into Roseland.
You must have stayed with him until Christmas?
Did you quit the band automatically because of the click in the band?
I got mad---well, Claude was featuring me a great deal.
He featueed me at the Appollo, but then the click got on him and then I guess he had to--

That's right, there were certain guys in that band, if they weren't featured, all of a sudden you're a new guy in the band, you're going to be featured that much, that means you're taking a whole lot away from the other man. We all know who that other man is, but we won't mention his name.
That's when I left the band.
